title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from surrounding pages). X = D_0 is a complex-analytic multiplicity (orbifold/stack), in the application the Deligne–Mumford–Knudsen compactification of M_{g,ν}. Θ is a normal-crossings divisor, here the boundary. D^{(p)} is the closed codimension-p locus where at least p branches of Θ meet. D_d is its normalization, i.e. the disjoint union of the local 'branches' of codimension d. D_{d,d'} for d>d' parametrizes pairs (a codimension-d branch, a codimension-d' branch containing it). More generally, D_{d_0,...,d_r} parametrizes flags of branches d_0>...>d_r≥0. These form a semi-simplicial system of analytic multiplicities, essentially the nerve of the category of strata.

On the previous page Grothendieck takes a closed Σ⊂Θ that is locally a union of irreducible components of the D^{(p)}; he calls such Σ 'Θ-admissible'. He sets D_d^Σ ⊂ D_d to be the union of the connected components of D_d that map into Σ. The key property: if a codimension-d' branch lies in Σ, then every deeper branch (codim d>d') inside it also lies in Σ.

This page:
- (250) He defines D_{d,d'}^Σ as the inverse image of D_{d'}^Σ under D_{d,d'}→D_{d'}. It is therefore a union of connected components of D_{d,d'}.
- (251) There is a span D_d^Σ ← D_{d,d'}^Σ → D_{d'}^Σ. The left arrow exists by the downward-closure property.
- (252) Σ is equivalent to the data of subsets π_0(D_d)^Σ ⊂ π_0(D_d), one for each d, satisfying the compatibility (251). That is, Σ is a downward-closed set (a sieve) in the poset/category of strata.
- (253) For each flag d_*, D^Σ_{d_0...d_r} is the inverse image of D^Σ_{d_r}, the condition being imposed on the largest stratum of the flag. Then D^Σ_{Δ_r} = ⊔ D^Σ_{d_0...d_r} is a semi-simplicial sub-system of analytic multiplicities. It is stable under all face maps: deleting d_r lands in D^Σ_{d_{r-1}} by downward closure, and the other faces keep d_r.
- He notes this corresponds to an ∞-/2-categorical object 𝒟^Σ of 'analytic categories'. The next page calls it a full 'strict' (sieve-like) sub-2-category.

Purpose. The next page states a 'van Kampen theorem (2nd version)': the topoi of punctured tubular neighbourhoods V^{Σ*} of the strata D_{d_0...d_r} form a semi-simplicial system of topoi. Its colimit is canonically equivalent to the topos V^*_{Σ,X}, the deleted neighbourhood of Σ in X, i.e. the 'structure at infinity' localized at Σ. This is a descent/gluing description of the homotopy type (fundamental groupoid) at infinity of M_{g,ν} near a closed union of boundary strata.
errors: The parenthetical in (250), '(c'est l'image inverse de D^Σ_d par D_{d,d'}→D_d !)', is false in general and contradicts the previous page. There Grothendieck correctly says the inverse image of D_d^Σ contains, but need not equal, the inverse image of D_{d'}^Σ. Counterexample: d'=0. D_0^Σ=∅ because Σ≠X, while D_d^Σ can be nonempty. The correct statement is an inclusion, which is exactly what is needed to get the arrow D^Σ_{d,d'}→D^Σ_d in (251).
Minor: 'système semi-simplicial' is right, since strict flags give no degeneracies. The identification with an ∞-/2-category 𝒟^Σ is only gestured at and left unfinished at the bottom of the page.

ideas.what: Θ-admissible closed subsets Σ of a normal-crossings boundary, encoded as downward-closed sets of connected components π_0(D_d)^Σ compatible along the flag correspondences
ideas.modern_name: sieve / closed union of strata in the poset of strata of a stratified space (normal crossings / toroidal stratification)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a relative version, for any closed union of boundary strata Σ, of the gluing description of the 'tube at infinity'. He frames it as a semi-simplicial system of analytic multiplicities corresponding to a strict (sieve) sub-∞-category of an ∞-category of 'analytic categories'. This anticipates viewing the stratified boundary of M̄_{g,ν} through its exit-path ∞-category, with the topos at infinity near Σ as a colimit over the corresponding sub-∞-category. The ∞-categorical formulation is left unfinished.

missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Modern work treats the boundary of M̄_{g,n} via the curve complex, log/Kato–Nakayama spaces and the Ivanov/Boggi 'complex of curves at infinity'. Making explicit a Σ-local van Kampen theorem in stack-theoretic, ∞-categorical form, a stratified homotopy hypothesis for DM stacks, is a natural and only partially documented formulation. Its main interest is historical: Grothendieck's ~1980s use of higher categories of strata for M_{g,ν}.

deep.surprise_reason: Mostly bookkeeping: defining the Σ-restricted strata and checking the semi-simplicial structure, with one small slip in the parenthetical of (250). The modestly notable aspect is the explicit link between the boundary-strata flag system of M_{g,ν} and an ∞-category of strata feeding a van Kampen theorem for neighbourhoods at infinity. This prefigures exit-path ∞-categories and Kato–Nakayama-style descriptions, but the ideas are now standard in other guises.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: the crossed-out text reads 'On désignera donc par D^Σ_{d,d'} l'image', replaced by 'posera donc'. The '76' at top is Grothendieck's own page number. The archive folio number 153 is at bottom left.
Equation label (252) is preceded by a struck-through 'π_0'.
The final line's '[-la une-] ∞-catégorie' is uncertain: the handwriting may read '2-catégorie' or similar. The next page speaks of a '2- -catégorie pleine stricte'.
In the parenthetical of (250), 'c'est [-aussi-]': the struck word is illegible but the sense is 'c'est (aussi) l'image inverse de D^Σ_d'.
